policy: Initial risks are hypotheses for review, not confirmed incidents. Ratings are provisional until evidence and accountable owners are recorded. Risk function may challenge or recommend stop; it cannot approve execution.

records.title: Control Centre remains a draft branch rather than an operating control plane
records.description: Governance, queue and reporting data may be mistaken for live coordination despite no deployed persistent dashboard or staffed handoff process.
required_actions: Review and integrate foundation branches only after explicit approval
Implement authenticated ownership, durable records and tested handoffs

records.title: Automation or model output could exceed intended authority
records.description: An agent, workflow or integration could perform external or consequential actions without the required approval boundary.
existing_controls: No live execution or wallet signing
required_actions: Test negative cases and audit trails

records.title: Candidate data source terms or data quality may not support intended use
records.description: Provider rights, Canadian eligibility, freshness, provenance or redistribution restrictions may be unknown or unsuitable.
required_actions: Complete source-by-source terms and Ontario review
Capture and validate sample data before any approval

records.title: Order, fill or position state may become uncertain during failure or restart
records.description: An ambiguous fill or persistence failure could cause duplicate or inconsistent position accounting.
required_actions: Execute offline restart/no-fill/fill reconciliation tests before any readiness upgrade

records.title: Recorded cash, revenue or commitments may be mistaken for verified bank balances
records.description: Internal ledgers may omit fees, timing, taxes, liabilities or external account activity.
existing_controls: Separate earned, accepted and cash-received states
required_actions: Define reconciliation evidence and owner review
Keep unverified external balances explicitly unknown

records.title: Incident response is not staffed or production-tested
records.description: A documented procedure may create false confidence without named responders, alert paths, secure evidence storage and rehearsals.
required_actions: Conduct a witnessed tabletop and recovery rehearsal

records.title: Storefront product economics and fulfilment may be commercially unviable
records.description: Listing price, shipping, platform fees, print cost, returns and delivery performance have not been re-audited against current data.
required_actions: Complete current read-only listing and unit-economics audit
Validate fulfilment and customer experience evidence

records.title: Creative assets and product functionality may drift or be lost during rebuild
records.description: Existing original characters, site functionality, data integrations and brand assets require a fresh inventory before changes.
existing_controls: Original character preservation task in OCC queue
required_actions: Inventory current assets and site state
Preserve source/export and identify known gaps before modifications
